votes.motion: Waive the Right of First Refusal for land located off Leominster Shirley Road, owned by Padula Lunenburg, LLC, limited to what is presented to the BOS.
votes.quote: mr. sund moved to waive the right of first refusal for land located off of leominster shirley road, owned by padula lunenburg, lic. limited to what is presented to the bos.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on the Request for Alteration of Licensed Premises for The Harley House.
votes.quote: mr. matthews moved to close the public hearing. mr. sund seconded. on vote, motion carried, 4 in favor, 0 opposed.

votes.motion: Approve the relocation of the bar as proposed on the plans submitted for the alteration of License Premises at 909 Mass Ave.
votes.quote: ms. bertram motioned to approve the relocation of the bar as proposed on the plans submitted for the alteration of license premises at 909 mass ave.

votes.motion: Retain the single uniform tax rate for the Town of Lunenburg for this year.
votes.quote: mr. debettencourt motioned to retain the single uniform tax rate for the town of lunenburg for this year, ms. bertram seconded.

votes.motion: Go into Executive Session under MGL Chapter 30A, Section 21(a)3, not to return to open session.
votes.quote: ms. bertram moved to go into executive session. mr. debettencourt seconded
the board voted unanimously to adjourn regular session at 7:55pm.

decisions.decision: No Board approval is needed for the holiday lighting project on the Upper Common, as it does not affect any right of way.
